title: TDQ_HANDOFF_PAYLOAD
description: Canonical unified subagent-to-leader handoff contract (digest <= 1,500 chars)

files.description: List of relative paths modified or audited by the subagent

merge_ready.description: Whether worktree branch is committed and ready to merge

tick_ready.description: Whether the leader can tick this task checkbox after merge

notes.description: Concise file:line — symbol — note digest (strictly <= 1,500 chars)

blocker.description: Explicit reason if execution failed or was blocked

model.description: Model ID used by the subagent

effort.description: Reasoning effort tier used by the subagent

elapsed_s.description: Optional elapsed execution time in seconds

worktree_required.description: Whether the task uses an isolated git worktree (false for artifact-only shards)
